title: AdaMenu: Query-Adaptive Menus for Decision Models over Large Label Spaces
abstract: arXiv:2611.19005v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Decision models such as Jev return probabilities over caller-defined options and are increasingly used for classification. Large label spaces challenge both accuracy and scalability: larger menus can impair decisions, increase input costs, and exceed option limits. Hierarchical classification reduces menu size but introduces serial calls and error propagation. We propose AdaMenu, which builds a compact candidate menu from retrieved labeled examples and makes a single decision-model request. Its candidate labels adapt to the query, and its default setting also adjusts menu size using aggregated retrieval scores. We evaluate AdaMenu with open and closed decision models on four label sets containing up to 1,016 labels. It outperforms TypeSafe's beam-search baseline on all 16 model and label-set pairs where both methods run, improving accuracy by 16.6-34.3 percentage points. translated_title: AdaMenu：面向大标签空间决策模型的查询自适应菜单
translated_abstract: 像Jev这样的决策模型会在调用者定义的选项上返回概率，并被越来越多地用于分类任务。大型标签空间在准确性和可扩展性两方面都带来挑战：更大的菜单会损害决策质量、增加输入成本，并超出选项数量限制。层次化分类可以缩小菜单规模，但会引入串行调用和错误传播问题。我们提出AdaMenu，它从检索到的带标注示例中构建一个紧凑的候选菜单，并只需发出一次决策模型请求。其候选标签会根据查询自适应调整，其默认设置还会利用聚合的检索分数来调整菜单大小。我们在包含多达1,016个标签的四个标签集上，使用开源和闭源决策模型对AdaMenu进行了评估。在两种方法均可运行的全部16个模型与标签集组合上，AdaMenu均优于TypeSafe的束搜索基线，准确率提升了16.6至34.3个百分点。相对于三个较小标签集上的完整菜单，准确率……（原文截断）
tldr: AdaMenu通过从检索到的带标注示例中构建查询自适应的紧凑候选菜单，仅需一次决策模型调用即可在大标签空间分类任务中大幅提升准确率（较束搜索基线提高16.6至34.3个百分点）。
en_tdlr: AdaMenu builds a query-adaptive compact candidate menu from retrieved labeled examples, requiring only a single decision-model call to substantially improve classification accuracy over large label spaces (16.6-34.3 percentage points above beam-search baselines).
